description.zh: 业务扩展信息，默认为一个空集合。
description.en: The business extension information. The default value is an empty collection.

description.zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码。
description.en: The flow code. View the flow code in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder).

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口获取流程详情，也可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面手动查看流程详情。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有创建成功的流程。

- 若您没有创建成功的流程，可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面手动创建流程或通过[CreateChatFlow](~~2937204~~)接口创建流程。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this API operation to retrieve the details of a flow. You can also view the flow details in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder).

- Before you call this operation, make sure that you have created a flow.

- If you have not created a flow, you can create one in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) or by calling the [CreateChatFlow](~~2937204~~) operation.
